HML.name: Height of the mandibular body at the mental foramen

TML.name: Mandibular body breadth at the mental foramen

states.label: Counter-winging: one or both maxillary central incisors' mesial margins are abnormally anterior to their distal margins, so that their lingual surfaces form a "V" with the apex pointing away anteriorly from the palate

ClavXL.name: Maximum length of the clavicle
ClavXL.definition: maximum distance between the most extreme ends of the clavicle.

ClavMXD.name: Maximum diameter of the clavicle at midshaft
ClavMXD.fullName: Maximum Diameter of the Clavicle at Midshaft
ClavMXD.definition: The maximum diameter of the bone measured at midshaft.

ClavMWD.name: Minimum diameter of the clavicle at midshaft
ClavMWD.fullName: Minimum Diameter of the Clavicle at Midshaft
ClavMWD.definition: The minimum diameter of the bone measured at midshaft.

ScH.name: Height of the scapula
ScH.definition: The distance from the most superior point of the cranial angle to the most interior point on the caudal angle

ScB.name: Breadth of the scapula
ScB.definition: The distance from the midpoint on the dorsal border of the glenoid fossa to midway between the two ridges of the scapular spine on the vertebral border

ScGB.name: Glenoid cavity breadth
ScGB.definition: Maximum distance from the ventral to dorsal margins of the glenoid cavity, taken perpendicular to glenoid cavity height. In cases of severe lipping, this measurement should not be taken (Martin and Knussmann 1988: 198, #13).

ScGH.name: Glenoid cavity height
ScGH.definition: The distance from the most superiorly located point on the margin of the glenoid cavity to the most inferiorly located point on the margin, taken perpendicular to glenoid cavity breadth. In cases of severe lipping, this measurement should not be taken. (Martin and Knussmann 1988: 198,#12).

HumXL.name: Maximum length of the humerus
HumXL.definition: The distance from the most superior point on the head of the humerus to the most inferior point on the trochlea

HumMXD.name: Maximum diameter of the humerus at midshaft
HumMXD.fullName: Maximum Diameter of the Humerus at Midshaft
HumMXD.definition: The maximum diameter of the humeral shaft at midshaft.

HumMWD.name: Minimum diameter of the humerus at midshaft
HumMWD.fullName: Minimum Diameter of the Humerus at Midshaft
HumMWD.definition: The minimum diameter of the humeral shaft at midshaft.

HumEB.name: Epicondylar breadth of the humerus
HumEB.definition: The distance from the most laterally protruding point on the lateral epicondyle to the corresponding projection on the medial epicondyle. (Martin and Knussmann 1988: 199, #4).

HumHXD.name: Maximum vertical diameter of the head of the humerus
HumHXD.fullName: Maximum Vertical Diameter of the Head of the Humerus
HumHXD.definition: The distance between the most superior and inferior points on the border of the articular surface.

RadXL.name: Maximum length of the radius
RadXL.definition: The distance from the most proximally positioned point on the head of the radius to the tip of the styloid process without regard to the long axis of the bone

RadMXD.name: Maximum diameter of the radius at midshaft
RadMXD.fullName: Maximum Diameter of the Radius at Midshaft
RadMXD.definition: The maximum diameter of the radial shaft taken at midshaft.

RadMWD.name: Minimum diameter of the radius at midshaft
RadMWD.fullName: Minimum Diameter of the Radius at Midshaft
RadMWD.definition: The minimum diameter of the radial shaft taken at midshaft.

RadHXD.name: Maximum diameter of the radial head
RadHXD.fullName: Maximum Diameter of the Radial Head
RadHXD.definition: The maximum diameter of the radial head measured on the margin of the head that articulates with the ulna. The bone is rotated until the maximum distance is obtained (Montagu 1960: 68).

UlnXL.name: Maximum length of the ulna
UlnXL.definition: The distance between the most proximal point on the olecranon and the most distal point on the styloid process

UlnMXD.name: Maximum midshaft diameter of the ulna
UlnMXD.fullName: Maximum Midshaft Diameter of the Ulna
UlnMXD.definition: The maximum diameter of the diaphysis at midshaft.

UlnMWD.name: Minimum midshaft diameter of the ulna
UlnMWD.fullName: Minimum Midshaft Diameter of the Ulna
UlnMWD.definition: The minimum diameter of the diaphysis at midshaft.

UlnPL.name: Physiological length of the ulna
UlnPL.definition: The distance between the deepest point on the articular surface of the coronoid process on the guiding ridge and the most inferior point on the distal articular surface of the ulna

UlnDWC.name: Minimum circumference of the ulna
UlnDWC.definition: The least circumference near the distal end of the bone

UlnOPXB.name: Olecranon breadth
UlnOPXB.definition: Measured from the medial and lateral margins of the olecranon process's articular surface at its greatest breadth (definition from Zobeck 1983). Per Martin and Knussman 1988 (206 #6), this is taken perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of the semilunar notch.

SacAH.name: Anterior height of the sacrum
SacAH.definition: The distance from the point on the promontory in the midsagittal plane to the corresponding point on the anterior border of the distal tip of the sacrum.

SacAB.name: Anterior breadth of the sacrum
SacAB.definition: The maximum transverse breadth of the sacrum at most anterior projection of the auricular surfaces (Martin and Knussmann 1988: 195, #5)

PUM.name: Acetabulo-symphyseal pubic length
PUM.definition: Minimum distance from the superior and medial point of the pubic symphysis to the nearest point on the acetabular rim at the level of the lunate surface

SPU.name: Cotylo-pubic breadth
SPU.definition: Pubic breadth between the most lateral acetabular point and the medial aspect of the pubis. Measurement is perpendicular to the major axis of the os pubis. Arms of the sliding caliper are thus parallel to the plane of the obturator foramen

DCOX.name: Maximum pelvic height
DCOX.definition: Maximum height of the os coxae measured from the inferior border of the os coxae to the most superior portion of the iliac crest. Can be taken with sliding calipers or osteometric board

IIMT.name: Depth of the greater sciatic notch
IIMT.fullName: Depth of the Greater Sciatic Notch
IIMT.definition: Distance from the postero-inferior iliac spine (defined as the point of intersection between the auricular surface and the posterior portion of the sciatic notch) to anterior border of the great sciatic notch. Axis of the measurement must be perpendicular to the anterior border. Because of the configuration of hip bone, it is easier to use small arms of sliding caliper.

ISMM.name: Post-acetabular ischium length
ISMM.definition: Distance from the most anterior and inferior point of the ischial tuberosity to the furthest point on the acetabular border

SCOX.name: Iliac breadth
SCOX.definition: Distance between the antero-superior iliac spine and the postero-superior iliac spine

SS.name: Spino-sciatic length
SS.definition: Minimum distance between the antero-inferior iliac spine and the deepest point in the greater sciatic notch

SA.name: Spino-auricular length
SA.definition: Distance between the antero-inferior iliac spine and the auricular point. Auricular point is defined as the intersection of the arcuate line with the auricular surface

SIS_PCMetric.name: Cotylo-sciatic breadth
SIS_PCMetric.definition: Distance between the lateral border of the acetabulum and the midpoint of the anterior portion of the greater sciatic notch. Fixed arm of the sliding caliper is parallel to the acetabular plane

VEAC.name: Vertical acetabular diameter
VEAC.definition: Maximum vertical diameter of the acetabulum, measured on the acetabular rim, as a prolongation of the longitudinal axis of the ischium

MA.name: Medial aspect of the ischiopubic ramus

FemXL.name: Maximum length
FemXL.definition: The distance from the most proximal point on the head of the femur to the most distal point on the medial or lateral femoral condyle (Martin and Knussmann 1988: 216, #1).

FemBL.name: Bicondylar length
FemBL.definition: The distance from the most proximal point on the head of the femur to a plane drawn between the inferior surfaces of the distal condyles

FemEB.name: Epicondylar breadth
FemEB.definition: The distance between the two most projecting points on the epicondyles

FemHXD.name: Head maximum diameter
FemHXD.fullName: Maximum Diameter of the Femur Head
FemHXD.definition: The maximum diameter of the femur head measured on the border of the articular surface. '

FemMXD.name: Midshaft maximum diameter
FemMXD.fullName: Maximum Midshaft Diameter of the Femur
FemMXD.definition: The maximum diameter of the femoral shaft taken at midshaft

FemMWD.name: Midshaft minimum diameter
FemMWD.fullName: Minimum Midshaft Diameter of the Femur
FemMWD.definition: The minimum diameter of the femoral shaft taken at midshaft.

FemMC.name: Circumference of the femur at midshaft
FemMC.fullName: Circumference of the Femur at Midshaft
FemMC.definition: The circumference measured at the midshaft.

FemSTD.name: Transverse subtrochanteric diameter of the femur
FemSTD.fullName: Transverse Subtrochanteric Diameter of the Femur
FemSTD.definition: The transverse diameter of the proximal portion of the diaphysis at the point of its greatest lateral expansion (see figure for approximate location on the femoral shaft for this measurement).

FemSAPD.name: Anterio-posterior subtrochanteric diameter of the femur
FemSAPD.fullName: Anterio-posterior Subtrochanteric Diameter of the Femur
FemSAPD.definition: The anterior-posterior diameter of the proximal end of the diaphysis measured perpendicular to the transverse diameter at the point of the greatest lateral expansion (See definition #79 for approximate location on the femoral shaft for this measurement.). This diameter is oriented perpendicular to the anterior surface of the femur neck. (Martin and Knussman 1988:217 #10).

FemLCAPD.name: Maximum antero-posterior length of the lateral condyle
FemLCAPD.fullName: Maximum Antero-Posterior Length of the Lateral Condyle
FemLCAPD.definition: The projected distance between the most posterior point on the lateral condyle and lip of the patellar surface taken perpendicular to the axis of the shaft.

FemMCAPD.name: Maximum antero-posterior length of the medial condyle
FemMCAPD.fullName: Maximum Antero-Posterior Length of the Medial Condyle
FemMCAPD.definition: The projected distance between the most posterior point on the medial condyle and the lip of the patellar surface taken perpendicular to the axis of the shaft.

TibCML.name: Condylo-malleolar length
TibCML.definition: The distance from the superior articular surface of the lateral condyle of the tibia to the tip of the medial malleolus (Martin and Knussmann 1988: 220, #1)

TibPEB.name: Proximal epiphyseal breadth
TibPEB.fullName: Maximum Proximal Epiphyseal Breadth of the Tibia
TibPEB.definition: The maximum distance between the two most projecting point on the margins of the medial and lateral condyles of the proximal epiphysis.

TibDEB.name: Distal epiphyseal breadth
TibDEB.fullName: Distal Epiphyseal Breadth of the Tibia
TibDEB.definition: The distance between the most medial point on the medial malleolus and the lateral surface of the distal epiphysis.

TibMXD.name: Midshaft maximum diameter
TibMXD.fullName: Maximum Midshaft Diameter of the Tibia
TibMXD.definition: The maximum diameter of the tibial shaft taken at midshaft.

TibMWD.name: Minimum midshaft diameter of the tibia
TibMWD.fullName: Minimum Midshaft Diameter of the Tibia
TibMWD.definition: The minimum diameter of the tibial shaft taken at midshaft.

TibMC.name: Circumference of the tibia at midshaft
TibMC.fullName: Circumference of the Tibia at Midshaft
TibMC.definition: The circumference measured at the level of the midshaft. (Martin and Knussmann 1988:574 #10a).

FibXL.name: Maximum length of the fibula
FibXL.definition: The maximum distance between the most superior point on the fibular head and the most inferior point on the lateral malleolus (Figure 3.26). (Martin and Knussmann 1988: 222, #1).

FibMXD.name: Maximum diameter of the fibula at midshaft
FibMXD.fullName: Maximum Diameter of the Fibula at Midshaft
FibMXD.definition: The maximum diameter at the midshaft. (Martin and Knussmann 1988: 222, #2).

CalcXL.name: Maximum length of the calcaneus
CalcXL.definition: The distance between the most posteriorly projecting point on the calcaneal tuberosity and the most anterior point on the superior margin of the articular facet for the cuboid measured in the sagittal plane (Figure 3.27). (Martin and Knussmann 1988:225 #1).

CalcB.name: Middle breadth of the calcaneus
CalcB.definition: The distance between the most laterally projecting point on the dorsal articular facet and the most medial point on the sustentaculum tali
